description: Screenshot of a tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), dated September 3, 2018, criticizing Democrats over their treatment of Attorney General Jeff Sessions and former FBI Director James Comey, saying they hated Comey until Trump fired him. The phrase 'Jeff Sessions, must love him now' is highlighted in yellow by whoever captured the screenshot.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Follow. ....The Democrats, none of whom voted for Jeff Sessions, must love him now. Same thing with Lyin' James Comey. The Dems all hated him, wanted him out, thought he was disgusting - UNTIL I FIRED HIM! Immediately he became a wonderful man, a saint like figure in fact. Really sick!. 11:39 AM - 3 Sep 2018. 11,693 Retweets 45,775 Likes. 13K 12K 46K

description: Organizational chart titled 'Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation', from the DOJ Inspector General report on the Clinton email (Midyear Exam) investigation. Boxes run from FBI Director James Comey down through Deputy Director Andrew McCabe/Mark Giuliano, Michael Steinbach/John Giacalone, the Counterintelligence Division (E.W. 'Bill' Priestap, Randy Coleman), Agent Lead Pete Strzok, Lead Analyst, and legal roles including Special Counsel Lisa Page, General Counsel Jim Baker, and NSCLB attorneys. Red annotations added by the poster label 'FBI Attorney 1' as Tashina 'Tash' Gauhar and 'FBI Attorney 2' as Kevin Clinesmith, and highlight Supervisory Special Agent Sally Moyer.
text: Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation. FBI Director James Comey. Chief of Staff Jim Rybicki. Deputy Director Andrew McCabe (February 2016-March 2018) Mark Giuliano (November 2013-January 2016). Special Counsel Lisa Page (February 2016-March 2018). NSB EAD Michael Steinbach (February 2016-February 2017) John Giacalone (July 2015-February 2016). Office of General Counsel Jim Baker. AD Counterintelligence Division (CD) E.W. "Bill" Priestap (January 2016-Present) Randy Coleman (May 2014-December 2015). NSCLB Deputy General Counsel Trisha Anderson. NSCLB Attorneys FBI Attorney 1 FBI Attorney 2. Agent Lead Pete Strzok. Lead Analyst. Tashina "Tash" Gauhar FBI Attorney 1. Kevin Clinesmith FBI Attorney 2. Supervisory Special Agent Sally Moyer.
flags: The red annotations identifying FBI Attorney 1 as Tashina Gauhar and FBI Attorney 2 as Kevin Clinesmith were added by the poster, not part of the original IG report figure; these are the poster's claims (Clinesmith as FBI Attorney 2 was later widely reported).
